title: Did Abraham truly love Isaac? Genesis 17:19 — the promised son and covenant
summary: Asks whether Abraham truly loved Isaac and shows Genesis 17:19, where God promises that Sarah will bear a son named Isaac and that His everlasting covenant will be established with him and his descendants.

text.text: 19 But God said, “No, but Sarah your wife will bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac; and I will establish My covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.

keywords: Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son
